result:
I evaluated the whole screen at `fluxo.html` and found 7 problems. The report was saved: the POST to `http://127.0.0.1:4100/api/submit` returned 200 with status `aceito`, and it's stored as `2026-09-18T09-15-22-com-run2-bc5e0f37.json`.

**Findings:**
- `.link-opcao` — `wcag:2.4.7` — The four links under "Outras opções de identificação" show no visible focus when you Tab to them: no outline, shadow, underline or colour change. The page's other controls do show a dashed outline.
- `#cpf` — `govbr-3.7.0-accessibility-global-cc837bbaf713` — After you submit an empty form, the CPF field isn't linked to its error message (no `aria-describedby`, no `aria-invalid`), and its border stays grey.
- `.mensagem-erro-cpf` — `wcag:4.1.3` — The error message "Informe um CPF para continuar." has no `role="alert"` or `aria-live`, and focus stays on the "Continuar" button, so screen readers don't announce it.
- `.mensagem-erro-cpf` — `ds-token-color` — The error text colour `#e60000` isn't a design-system colour. The validator's live check confirmed this.
- `.lista-opcoes` — `rule: null` — The list of login options is built from plain `div`s with no list roles, so it isn't exposed as a list. This probably falls under WCAG 1.3.1, but the validator didn't confirm that, so I left the rule empty.
- `.lista-opcoes` — `ds-token-color` — The list border colour `#dee2e6` isn't a design-system colour; the closest is `--gray-cool-10` (`#dfe1e2`).
- `.opcao-identificacao` — `ds-token-spacing` — All four option items have 13px padding, which is off the design system's spacing scale (multiples of 4px).

**What I tested:**
- Submitted an empty form.
- Submitted the form with "123".
- Tabbed through every control.
- Clicked "Alto Contraste".
- Ran two validator scans, one before and one after the empty submit.

**Uncertain, not reported (recorded in the report's notes):**
- Submitting "123" gives no feedback at all. This may just be how the demo behaves.
- "Alto Contraste" changes nothing visible.
- There's no link to skip to the main content.

**Dropped:**
- The validator flagged the `br-input` class sitting on the `<input>` element, but its own check rejected that (no rule backs it).
- Other validator notes (unrecognised class names, the 11px tag font size) aren't backed by a rule.
- Text contrast passes for both the tag and the error message.
- The only console error is a missing `favicon.ico` (404).
